## 2026-11-23 | ERCOT BESS Fleet (32 Nodes)

---

## 1. PERFORMANCE SUMMARY

Yesterday's fleet RT average of **$17.59/MWh** continues the recent pattern of moderate, range-bound pricing — sitting between the $16.36 low on 11-20 and the $28.75 peak on 11-21, confirming no structural price spike environment emerged overnight. The defining feature of 11-22 was **widespread negative pricing across 19 nodes**, the highest negative-price node count in the trailing 3-day window, driven by the dominant renewable supply mix: **20.3 GW wind + 22.0 GW solar against only 54.1 GW gross load** implies renewables covered ~78% of load, creating sustained supply pressure particularly in West Texas nodes. **PAVLOV_BT_RN** was the standout performer with a DA premium of **$19.57/MWh over RT**, anchored by its strong 5-day Sharpe of +1.057 and an MCC benefit of +$28.15/MWh — DA-committed assets at this node captured materially superior economics. At the bottom of the DART table, **CATARINA_B1 and FRMRSVLW_RN** showed near-zero DART divergence ($-0.04 and $-0.01 respectively), meaning RT essentially matched DA — neutral outcome regardless of dispatch channel. The 19 negative-price nodes represent a significant charging opportunity that was likely partially captured by RT-dispatched assets cycling during negative-price windows; this warrants post-settlement review against individual site SOC logs.
